column11: :TM("STACKABLE FRAMES" brush_gold [0.08em 0.35em]) Each panel contracts to its own content. The full column then repacks from the bottom with a real 1 mm gap.
column12: :TB("INLINE ICONS") One text flow can reserve a hole for :icon_orbit~[88%]5 icon_badge~[38%]3:. The star is layered above the orbit without a new SVG group.
column13: :TM("PATH DECORATOR" brush_cyan [0.05em 0.3em] front) This translucent stroke follows only the measured span while the paragraph remains editable.

column11: :TM("RICH XML" brush_gold) A dataset cell can combine :TB(bold) :TI(italic) and :Hi("custom color" #5ce1e6) as nested SVG tspans.
column12: :TB("MULTI-ICON HOLE") :icon_stack~[92%]5 icon_spark~[34%]9: shares one typographic slot. Fit Anchor controls every layer independently.
column13: :TM("NO FIXED HEIGHT" brush_cyan [0.05em 0.3em]) Add or remove a sentence. The panel and everything below it move automatically.

column11: :TM("SHARED MEASUREMENT" brush_gold [0.08em 0.35em]) Inline holes dynamic frames and decorators are measured together through one warm Inkscape shell.
column12: :TB("TRANSFORM IN PLACE") Rotate :icon_rotate~[82%]5^25: or offset artwork inside the hole without touching the surrounding text baseline.
column13: :TM("DATA-DRIVEN LENGTH" brush_cyan [0.02em 0.25em]) Each row controls the copy while the template keeps the visual system coherent.

column11: :TM("VARIABLE DATA" brush_cyan [0.08em 0.35em]) Every row may contain a different amount of text and still use the same Inkscape template.
column12: :TB("TEXT INSIDE ICONS") A reusable badge can receive its own value with :icon_badge.T{t=4}~[62%]5: while preserving the original vector artwork.
column13: :TM("EDITABLE OUTPUT" brush_cyan [0.02em 0.25em]) The result is still SVG. Inspect the tspans paths icons and private frames directly in Inkscape.
